# govspeak

**Tag**: library

## 简介

A set of extensions to markdown layered on top of the kramdown
library for use in the UK Government Single Domain project

## 官网

- 主页: http://github.com/alphagov/govspeak
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/govspeak/10.11.4
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/govspeak
